method: Each sample path from meta/sample.txt was matched to its catalog row by .path in records/*.jsonl and checked against the source file in the origin/main worktree. Scored fields: date, lab, line, mechanisms, outcome, headline_numbers, one_line for lab-record rows (7 fields); date, line, mechanisms, outcome, one_line for doc rows, whose schema has no lab or headline_numbers field (5 fields). Major = wrong outcome/verdict, wrong number, or misleading one_line. Milestone mismatches are listed as minor notes but excluded from error_rate_fields because milestone is not a scored field.
sample_note: meta/sample.txt lists 29 paths, not 30; all 29 were found in the catalog.

systematic_issues: Append-only September docs are catalogued from their header status, not their final appended result: #833 (HELD header, later rebuild executed and RATIFIED) and #1077 (contract header, later Observed result HELDOUT_PASSED) both get pre-result outcome and one_line. Both major errors in the sample are this pattern. 22 of the 155 doc-* records with outcome plan/blocked contain a Result/Outcome-type heading; these are unverified candidates for the same error (list reproducible by grepping those paths for '^#+ .*(Observed result|Actual result|Result|Outcome|rebuild executed)').

Anachronistic research lines for September docs: records dated 2026-09-02..09-22 are assigned October-era lines (m2-exact-memory, m1-discrete-attention) instead of native-geometric-sept / r4g1-transformerless (#1077, #1102, deepseek-grounded-lexical-realization).

Doc-kind rows have no lab or headline_numbers fields, and date is null when the source gives it only at month precision or in an evidence path (hologram: July 2026; text_attention_973: 2026-09-12). Results stated in such docs (64/64, 25,600 answers) are only in one_line, not machine-readable.

Milestone field for October pointer-copy records (answer-span-supervision, copy-span-oracle, span-extraction) is M2 although each source references #2029 (M1); the vocab maps pointer work to m2-exact-memory, so line and milestone diverge from the source's own filing.

Mechanism tagging is inconsistent for the native Source48/Generate64 M2 model: geometric-stack (m2-bottleneck-resume) vs native-geometric/carrier-credit (early-query-causal) vs legal-construction (prefix-vector-run) for the same model family; read-binding is applied to non-supervision read-out work.

headline_numbers are sometimes rounded rather than exact (prefix-vector-run combined CE to 4 dp), and one_line summaries occasionally drop a stated cost or caveat (quaternion 0.088 BPB cost; prefix-vector guard-unexamined caveat).
Parallel records of the same kind get different lines (a8 vs k16 current-status scope docs: m1-discrete-attention vs harness-governance).
Lab-record verdicts, lab attribution and headline numbers are otherwise accurate: 0 major errors in the 20 lab records; both major errors are in the 9 September doc records (2/9).
